title: Embervale (game)
tagline: A third-person 3D action RPG you can play in a phone browser.
stateNote: Run locally. No hosted copy I can verify is yours.
problem: Wake as the last Emberbound, restore three Shrines of Dawn, hunt relics and face the Hollow King, with a virtual stick and buttons on phones.
